items.q: Is there a free self-serve trial?
items.a: No. A 60-minute demo. After a qualified demo, sales may open a 14-day sandbox.

items.q: How is this different from a cheap CRM?
items.a: Cheap CRMs store contacts. PTTCRM shows which ads become contracts, and a portal per client.

items.q: Is Zalo on the English product?
items.a: Zalo is a Vietnam pack. English core: Meta + Google.
